about: Posts the lord at one spot to keep watch, for example on a road or at a crossing: a spot [pX_Y] named in an "ask the way" answer, or a holding (it stands at the gate, outside). It stays on its post and tells you each enemy army that comes within watch_radius of it, with its strength, where it is and what it is doing, and again when that army has gone out of sight. With also_lords 1 it tells you of enemy lords too. Its caution makes it fall back from anything too strong, and it goes back to its post once the danger has passed.
calls_back: it reaches its post, an enemy army (or with also_lords, an enemy lord) comes within watch_radius of it, and when that one is out of sight again

watch_radius: how far from the post an enemy is reported, in map units (a lord sees about 10 to 15)
also_lords: 1 also reports enemy lords that are not in an army

when.poke: {me} has taken up the watch at {at}.

when.if: army_near(at, watch_radius) != none and army_near(at, watch_radius) != reported
when.poke: {me}, keeping watch at {at}, sees an enemy army: {army_near(at, watch_radius)}, {men_of(army_near(at, watch_radius))} men, strength {strength_of(army_near(at, watch_radius))}, {distance(army_near(at, watch_radius), at)} from the post; {doing_of(army_near(at, watch_radius))}; {where_of(army_near(at, watch_radius))}.

when.if: also_lords > 0 and nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius) != none and nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius) != reported and nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius) != reported_lord
when.poke: {me}, keeping watch at {at}, sees an enemy lord: {nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius)}, {men_of(nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius))} men, strength {strength_of(nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius))}, {distance(nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius), at)} from the post; {doing_of(nearest_enemy(at, watch_radius))}.
{me}, keeping watch at {at}: {gone_army} has gone out of sight; when last seen it was {doing_of(gone_army)}, {where_of(gone_army)}.
